title: GraphSmith trace-mode + redaction policy (R4)
description: Declarative policy for how much of the execution trace a bundle carries (`trace_mode`) and the redaction rules applied before sealing. The redaction mechanism preserves the trace hash chain (redactions[] are recorded, not silently dropped). A leaked secret in an exported trace is a fail-closed defect. Frozen Wave 0 (v0.4.0).

trace_mode.description: full = complete trace; redacted = trace with redaction rules applied (redactions[] recorded, hash chain intact); metadata-only = step shape/status without payloads.

redaction_rules.description: Rules applied before sealing. Measured by a recall-gated secret/PII conformance battery.

replacement.description: What redacted content is replaced with (a hash reference by default, so the chain stays intact).
